messages:
Lee (eng-security): FYI we're planning an egress-hardening rollout in us-west-2 tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Staging showed an interaction where new deny rules plus higher logshipper sampling caused STS:TagSession to be effectively dropped for ephemeral node roles and KMS grants failed. GPU warm-pool nodes hit 'bootstrap locking'. Need quick mitigations.

Maya (eng-platform): ouch. can we temporarily whitelist the keystore-proxy IPs/CIDRs to let bootstrap traffic through?

Ashok (eng-infra): reproduced in staging. Two issues colliding: 1) NAT conntrack saturation from logshipper burst delaying outbound to KMS/STS, 2) IAM diff removed TagSession which made grants reject even when network was fine.

Jordan (eng-sre): quick mitigation options: A) allowlist keystore-proxy CIDRs B) revert IAM deny for sts:TagSession for service roles C) throttle logshipper sampling D) increase conntrack. Which is fastest?

Lee (eng-security): A and C are fastest. B requires policy review but is small. D needs infra deploy with host sysctl + rolling restarts (~20m). Note: TagSession deny caused KMS grant 'shadow' errors seen in logs.

Maya (eng-platform): I'll ping @security-policy. We should scope an IAM exception: keep sts:TagSession for arn:aws:iam::*:role/redwood-service/* and deny broadly otherwise.

security-policy: Ack, will review minimal policy patch. We can approve scoped TagSession allow for service roles if canary passes.

Ashok (eng-infra): conntrack bump is nontrivial during business hours. Recommend: 1) apply allowlist on canary cluster 2) throttle logshipper to previous sampling rate (runtime flag) 3) apply IAM patch to keep TagSession for service roles 4) schedule conntrack sysctl bump in a low-traffic window and roll warm-pool nodes there first.

Lee (eng-security): agreed. I'll trigger allowlist change for usw2-canary and monitor KMS auth success. Tagging @deploy-bot and @oncall-sre-bot.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: firewall/egress-exception/usw2-keystore -> canary -> rollout (triggered by Lee). ETA 3m.

oncall-sre-bot: Watching warm-pool health; will escalate on >4m bootstrap stalls.

Maya (eng-platform): Allowlist applied to canary. Initial metrics: KMS auth failures dropped to baseline, GPU nodes progressing from 'locking' -> 'ready'. Monitoring 15m.

Jordan (eng-sre): Canary passed at +10m. Proceed with IAM policy patch to retain sts:TagSession for service roles in staging. I'll also apply logshipper throttle now.

security-policy: IAM patch reviewed and approved for scoped TagSession allow. Patch: keep sts:TagSession effect Allow for arn:aws:iam::*:role/redwood-service/*, Deny remains for others.

Ashok (eng-infra): pushed logshipper sampling rollback to staging (runtime). Observability shows conntrack pressure easing. Scheduling conntrack bump for 02:00-02:30 UTC low window, will canary in eu-west-1 first.

Maya (eng-platform): plan to roll IAM patch + logshipper throttle to prod after 30m observation in staging. Long-term: consider privatelink to keystore to avoid NAT/conntrack and reduce flakiness (but cost overhead).

Lee (eng-security): thanks. I'll write a short postmortem in #eng-platform outlining root cause (egress policy + conntrack + IAM TagSession removal), short-term mitigations, and long-term actions: privatelink for keystore, conntrack autoscale, and stricter e2e staging tests for ephemeral role paths.
